# TokenRevocation

- Source URL: https://developer.ebay.com/api-docs/static/pn_token-revocation.html

## Description

eBay sends a TokenRevocation notification to the subscriber when an application revokes a user token. Data Fields Returned API Call that displays this notification: GetTokenStatus The data fields returned by the TokenRevocation notification are the same as those for GetTokenStatus . Refer to the GetTokenStatus call reference documentation for additional information. Refer to SOAP Message Body for information about the standard elements returned for all notifications.
